state_queries.scheduled: SELECT count(*) FROM awa.deferred_jobs WHERE state = 'scheduled'
state_queries.retryable: SELECT count(*) FROM awa.deferred_jobs WHERE state = 'retryable'
state_queries.dead: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM awa.done_entries WHERE state = 'failed') + (SELECT count(*) FROM awa.dlq_entries)
state_queries.running: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM awa.leases WHERE state = 'running') + (SELECT count(*) FROM awa.lease_claims c WHERE c.closed_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.lease_claim_closures x WHERE x.claim_slot = c.claim_slot AND x.job_id = c.job_id AND x.run_lease = c.run_lease) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.lease_claim_closure_batches b WHERE b.claim_slot = c.claim_slot AND b.receipt_ranges @> c.receipt_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.done_entries d WHERE d.job_id = c.job_id AND d.run_lease = c.run_lease) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.deferred_jobs d WHERE d.job_id = c.job_id AND d.run_lease = c.run_lease) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.dlq_entries d WHERE d.job_id = c.job_id AND d.run_lease = c.run_lease) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM awa.leases l WHERE l.job_id = c.job_id AND l.run_lease = c.run_lease))

evidence_queries.rescued_attempts: WITH rescued AS (SELECT job_id, run_lease FROM awa.lease_claim_closures WHERE outcome = 'rescued' UNION ALL SELECT item.job_id, item.run_lease FROM awa.lease_claim_closure_batches AS closures JOIN awa.lease_claim_batches AS claims ON claims.claim_slot = closures.claim_slot AND claims.receipt_ranges && closures.receipt_ranges CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(claims.job_ids, claims.run_leases, claims.receipt_ids) AS item(job_id, run_lease, receipt_id) WHERE closures.outcome = 'rescued' AND closures.receipt_ranges @> item.receipt_id) SELECT count(*) FROM rescued
evidence_queries.rescued_jobs_completed: WITH rescued AS (SELECT job_id, run_lease FROM awa.lease_claim_closures WHERE outcome = 'rescued' UNION ALL SELECT item.job_id, item.run_lease FROM awa.lease_claim_closure_batches AS closures JOIN awa.lease_claim_batches AS claims ON claims.claim_slot = closures.claim_slot AND claims.receipt_ranges && closures.receipt_ranges CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(claims.job_ids, claims.run_leases, claims.receipt_ids) AS item(job_id, run_lease, receipt_id) WHERE closures.outcome = 'rescued' AND closures.receipt_ranges @> item.receipt_id), completed AS (SELECT job_id, run_lease FROM awa.done_entries WHERE state = 'completed' UNION ALL SELECT item.job_id, item.run_lease FROM awa.receipt_completion_batches AS batches CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(batches.job_ids, batches.run_leases) AS item(job_id, run_lease)) SELECT count(DISTINCT rescued.job_id) FROM rescued JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT job_id FROM completed) AS done USING (job_id)
evidence_queries.rescued_attempts_completed: WITH rescued AS (SELECT job_id, run_lease FROM awa.lease_claim_closures WHERE outcome = 'rescued' UNION ALL SELECT item.job_id, item.run_lease FROM awa.lease_claim_closure_batches AS closures JOIN awa.lease_claim_batches AS claims ON claims.claim_slot = closures.claim_slot AND claims.receipt_ranges && closures.receipt_ranges CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(claims.job_ids, claims.run_leases, claims.receipt_ids) AS item(job_id, run_lease, receipt_id) WHERE closures.outcome = 'rescued' AND closures.receipt_ranges @> item.receipt_id), completed AS (SELECT job_id, run_lease FROM awa.done_entries WHERE state = 'completed' UNION ALL SELECT item.job_id, item.run_lease FROM awa.receipt_completion_batches AS batches CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(batches.job_ids, batches.run_leases) AS item(job_id, run_lease)) SELECT count(*) FROM rescued JOIN completed USING (job_id, run_lease)
evidence_queries.jobs_completed_twice: WITH completed AS (SELECT job_id, run_lease FROM awa.done_entries WHERE state = 'completed' UNION ALL SELECT item.job_id, item.run_lease FROM awa.receipt_completion_batches AS batches CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(batches.job_ids, batches.run_leases) AS item(job_id, run_lease)) SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT job_id FROM completed GROUP BY job_id HAVING count(*) > 1) AS twice
evidence_queries.heartbeat_age_max_s: SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM clock_timestamp() - min(heartbeat_at)), 0) FROM (SELECT heartbeat_at FROM awa.leases WHERE state IN ('running', 'waiting_external') UNION ALL SELECT heartbeat_at FROM awa.attempt_state) AS beats WHERE heartbeat_at IS NOT NULL
